p, k = map(int, input().split())

Mod = 1000000007

def fast_pow(a, p):
    res = 1
    base = a % Mod
    while p > 0:
        if p & 1:
            res = (res * base) % Mod
        base = (base * base) % Mod
        p >>= 1
    return res

if k == 0:
    print(fast_pow(p, p - 1))
elif k == 1:
    print(fast_pow(p, p))
else:
    used = [False] * (p + 1)
    ans = 1
    groups = 0
    for x in range(1, p):
        if used[x]:
            continue
        groups += 1
        ans = (ans * p) % Mod
        v = x
        while not used[(v * k) % p]:
            used[(v * k) % p] = True
            v = (v * k) % p
    print(ans)
